verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list speculative decoding as a feature and name several techniques: n-gram, suffix, EAGLE and DFlash. That directly covers the power-user story of speeding up generation. The evidence is a single feature-list line, with no dedicated feature page and no hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed configuration/usage documentation for speculative decoding, measured speedup benchmarks, independent or community corroboration.
